tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return Ayush Rai's public profile summary from life.ayushrai.site, including roles and location. Optional include_contact adds the published email and phone.

include_contact.description: Include the published email and phone in the summary.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Return Ayush Rai's published email, phone, and booking links from the contact page. Optional channel filters to email, phone, or booking.

channel.description: Optional filter: email, phone, or booking.

tools.name: search_public_facts
tools.description: Search public life.ayushrai.site pages by a short query and return matching published facts. Do not use this for private data.

query.description: Words to match against public pages.

tools.name: book_a_conversation
tools.description: Return Ayush Rai's public Calendly, Cal.com, and Topmate booking links so the caller can schedule time. This tool does not create a booking itself.
